models.name: ARGUS-PRISM WarmthScore
models.one_liner: Six weighted behavioural signals -- velocity, round-trip, structuring, dormant-device, profile mismatch, SIM swap.
models.method_note: Their six signal functions and their published weights, reimplemented from ARGUS-PRISM/backend/app/engines/warmthscore/signals.py and evaluated as of the complaint time instead of the wall clock. Their SIM-swap signal needs a telco feed this dataset does not have, so 10 of their 100 points are unavailable in every case.

models.name: MULE_HUNTER graph model
models.one_liner: Graph-topology features -- PageRank, reciprocity, ring membership, community and second-hop fraud rate.
models.method_note: Their feature set, computed exactly as their feature_engineering.py computes it. Their SAGE->GAT network needs torch_geometric and its own training corpus, neither of which travels with this repo, so the features are read by a logistic model fitted on training-ring incidents. Their features, our learner -- and their two guilt-by-association features are computed from accounts already known to be mules, which is what a deployed version would actually see.

operating_point.calibration_note: All four systems may flag at most 12 accounts on this case. A bank's investigation desk has a fixed daily capacity, so this is the comparison that matches how the alerts would actually be worked.

equal_alert_budget.calibration_note: All four systems may flag at most 12 accounts on this case. A bank's investigation desk has a fixed daily capacity, so this is the comparison that matches how the alerts would actually be worked.

equal_fpr.calibration_note: Thresholds chosen per system so all four flag the same 12% of the innocent accounts in this case.

native.calibration_note: Each system at its own published threshold. The operating points differ, so the counts are not directly comparable -- which is the point of the other two modes.

models.name: Mule-Account PoC (Isolation Forest)
models.one_liner: Isolation Forest over seven account features, ranked by shared devices, velocity and degree centrality.
models.method_note: Run as written: the same seven features, StandardScaler, IsolationForest(contamination=0.12, random_state=42) and their own risk_score ranking formula. Their contamination setting is a published threshold, so it becomes their native operating point.

operating_point.calibration_note: All four systems may flag at most 12 accounts on this case. A bank's investigation desk has a fixed daily capacity, so this is the comparison that matches how the alerts would actually be worked.

equal_alert_budget.calibration_note: All four systems may flag at most 12 accounts on this case. A bank's investigation desk has a fixed daily capacity, so this is the comparison that matches how the alerts would actually be worked.

equal_fpr.calibration_note: Thresholds chosen per system so all four flag the same 12% of the innocent accounts in this case.

native.calibration_note: Each system at its own published threshold. The operating points differ, so the counts are not directly comparable -- which is the point of the other two modes.

recovery_model.description: Stolen funds become unrecoverable as they are forwarded onward or cashed out. Freezing an account at time t recovers the stolen money still sitting in it at t. Freezing also locks the holder's own balance, which is what the wrongly-frozen figure prices.

weakness_note: We win this case on net benefit but still miss 79 mule account(s). Our earliest correct flag lands at hop 2; anything the money reached before that is already spent by the time the freeze arrives.
